correctness.rationale: The period-doubling substitution μ(0)=01, μ(1)=00 produces two halves of P_j agreeing except for their last letter. Every one occurs at an odd position and there is no 11 or 0000, so two identical length≥4 factors start with the same parity. Induction on the substitution level shows all length-h factors of P_k are distinct and the unique repeated length-(h−1) factor is Q_k at starts 0,h. A minimal absent word of length ℓ≥3 has both length-(ℓ−1) borders present but its interior must repeat at different starts, forcing ℓ≤h+1. The left/right contexts of Q_k permit only c_k Q_k c_k absent with both borders present. For all k≥3, c_k=(k−1) mod2; no circular or arbitrary-prefix claim.
